name: commander-static-completion
description: Generate standalone shell completions from Commander command definitions

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.js && npm run test:release
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src scripts test examples type-tests
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run check:release && npm test && npm run test:package
scripts.test:snapshots: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/snapshots.test.js test/generated-snapshots.test.js test/loading.test.js test/executable.test.js
scripts.test:snapshots:update: npm run build && UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/snapshots.test.js test/generated-snapshots.test.js test/loading.test.js test/executable.test.js
